sources.entry: Vinyl Cache - Web application accelerator/caching HTTP reverse proxy (formerly Varnish). (Source Code) BSD-2-Clause Go/deb/Docker

summary.name: Vinyl Cache
summary.one_liner: Vinyl Cache (formerly Varnish Cache) is a web application accelerator, a caching HTTP reverse proxy installed in front of any HTTP server.
keywords: reverse proxy in front of web server
use_cases: Speed up delivery of a website or web application by caching responses
Place in front of any HTTP server as a caching reverse proxy
Filter request or response headers as a basic WAF
Inspect or modify request and response bodies with regular expressions
Monitor the cache with OpenTelemetry instrumentation
summary.what_it_does: Vinyl Cache is a caching HTTP reverse proxy that sits in front of any server speaking HTTP and caches its content to speed up delivery. The page claims a 300-1000x speedup depending on architecture. It is configured through VCL and extended with VMODs, with tutorials covering re2-based header filtering, regex matching and replacement in bodies, and TLS handling with haproxy. The project publishes bi-annual feature releases and security releases addressing listed vulnerabilities, and offers VCOT for OpenTelemetry instrumentation. The page also lists a crash-checking tutorial and an article on integrating Iocaine for AI crawler defense.
notable: Formerly Varnish Cache; renamed to Vinyl Cache while Varnish Software continues a separate Varnish Cache project
Configured via VCL with VMOD extensions such as re2 and re
Regular security advisories (VSV numbers) and bi-annual feature releases
Licensed BSD-2-Clause according to the awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: Name change is in progress, so Vinyl and Varnish naming may be mixed up on the project and related sites
Versions 8.0 and 7.7 series are no longer supported, per the release news
